parties.note: Founded as the Party of Social Democracy in Romania (PDSR) on 10 July 1993; took its current name when it merged with the Romanian Social Democratic Party (PSDR) on 16 June 2001. Led the Social Democratic Pole (with PSDR and PUR) in 2000, National Union PSD+PUR in 2004, the PSD+PC alliance in 2008 and the Social Liberal Union (USL) in 2012. Iliescu led it from January 1997 (month only in the source). Short acting leaderships not recorded as people: Rovana Plumb (24 June-22 July 2015) and Victor Negrescu (25 November-3 December 2024, during which Ciolacu stepped aside); Ciolacu's entry spans that gap.

parties.popularity_note: Estimate: the PNL ran inside the CDR in 1996 (CDR 30.17%); 8.7% is the liberal members' share of the CDR vote by seat allocation. In 2000 it ran alone and won 6.89%.
parties.note: Re-founded in January 1990. Member of the CDR until 2000; part of the Justice and Truth Alliance (DA) with the PD in 2004, of the USL in 2012 and of the Christian Liberal Alliance with the PDL in 2014. The PDL merged into the PNL on 17 November 2014 (the merged party kept the PNL name). The Wikipedia leadership table gives 28 June 2014 as the start of Iohannis's leadership but computes its duration from 2 June. Gaps are acting leaders not recorded as people: Raluca Turcan (13 December 2016-17 June 2017) and Gheorghe Flutur (2-10 April 2022). Described as liberal conservative; in 2000 it belonged to the liberal family (ELDR) and joined the EPP later.
